title: A 7-eV bandgap semiconductor based on silicon-doped α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3
title_zh: 基于硅掺杂的α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3的7 eV带隙半导体
abstract: In rectifying power electronics, wider-bandgap (Eg) semiconductors allow higher efficiency and power density with the Baliga figure of merit proportional to Eg5.5 (refs. 1,2). Unfortunately, the unique ability of semiconductors to have their conductivities controllably modulated over orders of magnitude by equilibrium doping methods becomes increasingly elusive as the bandgap increases. Increasing demand for wider-bandgap semiconductors has led to many materials previously considered insulators—including GaN, SiC, AlN, Ga2O3 and GeO2—to emerge as useful semiconductors after decreasing defect densities and finding appropriate dopants. Here we report silicon-doped α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3 films with bandgaps exceeding 7.0 eV grown by suboxide molecular-beam epitaxy, surpassing that of cubic boron nitride, the next-widest-bandgap semiconductor known3–5. In the colossal-bandgap regime, >6 eV, our silicon-doped α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3 films have room-temperature conductivities over 100 million times higher than all previous reports6. We fabricate a Schottky diode and a field-effect transistor (the AlphaFET) with colossal-bandgap channels. These α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3 films and devices use sapphire, an abundant, inexpensive substrate with excellent quality that is produced at massive scale, facilitating the development and adoption of colossal-bandgap electronics. Our achievement breaks the trend of increasing synthesis difficulty, cost and small size of ever-wider-bandgap semiconductors, for example, diamond and cubic boron nitride. Suboxide molecular-beam epitaxy is used to grow silicon-doped α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3 films with bandgaps exceeding 7.0 eV, enabling the fabrication of a Schottky diode and a field-effect transistor with colossal-bandgap channels.
abstract_zh: 在整流功率电子学中，更宽带隙（Eg）半导体可实现更高的效率和功率密度，巴利加因子的优势与Eg5.5成正比（refs. 1,2）。遗憾的是，半导体在平衡掺杂方法下将电导率可控调节数个数量级的独特能力，随着带隙的增大而日益难以企及。对更宽带隙半导体的需求日益增长，已促使许多此前被视为绝缘体的材料——包括GaN、SiC、AlN、Ga2O3和GeO2——在缺陷密度降低和找到合适掺杂剂后，成为有用的半导体。在此，我们报道了通过亚氧化物分子束外延生长的硅掺杂α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3薄膜，其带隙超过7.0 eV，超过了已知的下一个最宽带隙半导体 cubic boron nitride（ cubic boron nitride，以下简称 c-BN）的带隙3–5。在>6 eV的巨宽带隙区域，我们的硅掺杂α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3薄膜在室温下的电导率比以往所有报道高出100多倍6。我们制备了肖特基二极管和基于巨宽带隙通道的场效应晶体管（AlphaFET）。这些α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3薄膜和器件采用石英石作为基底，石英石丰富、成本低，且品质优良，大规模生产，有助于巨宽带隙电子学的开发和应用。我们的成就打破了 ever-wider-bandgap semiconductors（更宽带隙半导体）合成难度增加、成本上升和尺寸缩小的趋势，例如 diamond（钻石）和 cubic boron nitride（ cubic boron nitride）。使用亚氧化物分子束外延可生长出带隙超过7.0 eV的硅掺杂α-(AlxGa1−x)2O3薄膜，从而实现基于巨宽带隙通道的肖特基二极管和场效应晶体管的制备。
